label: thm:q-bkm
title: $q$-deformed Beale--Kato--Majda criterion
html:
Let v be the solution of the q-NS system with q > 1 on [0, T) and let \omega_q = d_q v be the q-vorticity. Then v extends smoothly beyond T if and only if \int_0^T \lVert \omega_q(t) \rVert_{L^\infty}dt < \infty.

Since well-posedness solutions are global for q > 1, the integral is always finite when q > 1. The criterion becomes non-trivial only in the q \to 1 limit.

Shared substrate. Boundedness of \int_0^T \lVert \omega_q \rVert_{L^\infty}\,dt is the regularity leg of the shared length-filtration trichotomy on the Skein substrate \mathcal{S}(q) (one length filtration, three problems): q-Navier--Stokes asks the crossing-number filtration \ell (the vortex-knot complexity) to stay bounded — no finite-time blow-up — the same \ell that q-Collatz asks to descend and \mathrm{P} vs \mathrm{NP} asks to be polynomially reachable. All three are one shared object, QOU.Information.SkeinObservationSystem (regularity is Regular / regular_of_len_nonincreasing, the abstract shadow of this criterion).
